name: Desktop Replicator
revision: Rev S, default build with the M1 cassette
exportHeader: Desktop Replicator Rev F (`desktop`) — generated by fieldc desktop export
frame: z up, floor at z = 0, front at +x

assemblies.title: Base and plinth foot
assemblies.summary: The rounded-square foot that holds the power supply, the circuit boards and the lower plate.

assemblies.title: Boards and power
assemblies.summary: The backplane, the plug-in compute card, the clock and the power supply.

assemblies.title: Lower acoustic plate
assemblies.summary: A thin glass wafer with six piezo discs behind it, set in the plinth. It is the floor of the build chamber.

assemblies.title: Storage bucket
assemblies.summary: A fixed glass tube straight under the chamber. It is the store for feedstock.

assemblies.title: Mid-plane slot
assemblies.summary: The ring and three balls that the cassette sits on, between the bucket and the build chamber.

assemblies.title: Mid-plane cassette
assemblies.summary: A tray with a flat glass wafer and a hard metal ring. It reflects sound up and lifts out by hand.

assemblies.title: Chamber seal
assemblies.summary: A soft gasket where the lifting glass tube lands.

assemblies.title: Lifting glass tube and rear liner
assemblies.summary: The glass tube that closes the build chamber, its carrier ring and the rear liner. It rises with the head.

assemblies.title: Laser ring
assemblies.summary: Two strips of small lasers that look across the chamber. Each laser is also its own detector.

assemblies.title: Rear tower and lift drive
assemblies.summary: The hollow rear column and the two fixed corner pieces. They hold the ball screws, the guide carriages, the servo and the belts that raise the head, and carry cooling air.

assemblies.title: Upper acoustic plate
assemblies.summary: The matching wafer and piezo discs in the head. It is the ceiling of the build chamber.

assemblies.title: Head
assemblies.summary: The lid that carries the upper plate and the gap actuators.

assemblies.title: Touchscreen wedge
assemblies.summary: A hollow aluminium wedge on the front of the base, tilted 45 degrees. It carries a 7-inch touchscreen, a status light and a USB-C socket.
